blockers: At native 1x the face collapses into a pale rectangular mask with indistinct eyes and no convincing stylized facial planes. Celina reads as a mannequin rather than a deliberate, controlled duelist.

The base silhouette is too close to a generic upright blue uniform figure. The long narrow legs, blocky torso, tucked arms, and small feet do not establish a distinctive Celina-specific contour beyond the rapier.

The navy hair, central torso, boots, and shadowed garment regions merge into the dark background at 1x. Brass and light-blue accents provide isolated highlights but do not create a reliable material hierarchy.

The idle strip is functionally a held pose with minimal breathing or posture change. Controlled restraint has become visual inactivity; there is no readable tension, release, or subtle weight adjustment.

The locomotion cycles lack convincing contact, down, passing, and up phases. The legs swing as narrow pendulums while the pelvis and shoulders remain largely locked, creating an ice-skating impression despite the zero-pixel global anchor drift.

The gesture strip communicates a sword trajectory more strongly than a character action. The torso, shoulder, wrist, and planted-leg mechanics do not contribute enough to make the signature gesture feel deliberate or uniquely Celina's.
Secondary motion is effectively absent. Hair, coat or skirt mass, trim, and weapon follow-through remain rigid, so the restrained archetype has no controlled overlap or settle behavior.
high_value_changes: Rebuild the canonical 1x silhouette around a stronger asymmetric duelist shape: clearer head-and-hair volume, a more forceful shoulder-to-waist taper, readable corset mass, differentiated arms, and a visibly planted boot structure.
Redesign the face and hair at native scale with a small number of decisive value planes and landmarks. The face must remain readable without magnification or reliance on light-background inspection.

Re-author all locomotion directions from explicit contact, down, passing, and up keys. Keep the planted foot pixel-stable while adding knee compression, pelvis travel, hip/shoulder counter-rotation, and reciprocal arm action.

Ret time the idle and signature gesture around anticipation, a controlled hold, decisive rapier motion, overshoot, and settle. Preserve the contained amplitude but make the force changes unmistakable.
Increase value separation between obsidian hair, navy cloth, blue sleeves, metal, brass, skin, and boots so each material survives both dark and light background tests.
Add restrained secondary overlap to the hair, garment hem, trim, and rapier hand so the animation feels intentional rather than mechanically posed.
optional_notes: The stated 115.6px standing height and 0.0px anchor drift satisfy the hard scale and anchor requirements.
The 8-direction coverage and frame-count validation are complete, but coverage alone does not establish professional locomotion quality.
The static sheet reports 116.0px while the technical summary reports 115.6px; both are compliant, but the reporting should use one standardized measurement.
strongest_improvements: Scale compliance is clean, with the character substantially below the 128px ceiling.
The ground anchor is stable at 0.0px drift across the submitted validation.
The rapier creates useful asymmetry and remains one of the clearest readable elements in the gesture and directional sheets.
The blue, light-blue, white, and brass accents establish a usable starting palette, even though the dark regions still merge at native scale.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the native-1x canonical sprite and rederive the cycles from it, prioritizing a distinctive asymmetric silhouette, a readable face, and explicit planted-leg weight transfer before adding further animation polish.
